notes.title: Zombies and Strangers, Releasing on June 17, 2025!
notes.notes:
It's been a long time coming. [b]Zombies and Strangers[/b] will be released on June 17, 2025!

As a solo game developer, It took me years to develop and get this game up to this point, and it's finally releasing very soon!

Thank you so much for all the support! I hope you give this game a try. It's something I built with dedication and passion, both as a game developer and a gamer.

notes.title: Zombies and Strangers is playable on Steam Deck!
notes.notes:
I would like to announce that [b]Zombies and Strangers[/b] is playable on [b]Steam Deck[/b] via [b]Steam Input Keyboard Mouse to Controller Mapping Support![/b]

Although the game currently has no in-game controller support, with [b]Steam Input[/b], you can manually map and configure keyboard and mouse actions to a controller. You can also use the Official template I have created specifically designed to play the game properly using a standard controller or Steam Deck. Additionally, I have tested the game and it can run up to 60fps!

Thank you so much for your support! Zombies and Strangers is coming very soon. Stay tuned!
Please follow me on [b][url=https://www.instagram.com/jieasobi/]Instagram[/url][/b] for more gameplay showcase and updates!
